key_events.text: Martin Winkler first to announce candidacy; founds city party Dunaj (registered Nov 2025).
Transport minister Jozef Ráž (Smer nominee) announces run as independent.
Dana Čahojová (long-time district mayor) drops out before filing deadline.
Miroslav Heredoš withdraws for health reasons.
Martin Winkler (Dunaj) withdraws in favour of Ráž; Ráž promises him 1st deputy mayor post. Race effectively Vallo vs Ráž.
Vallo–Ráž TV duel on Markíza 'Na telo'; Vallo pre-election concert on Hlavné námestie; Vallo campaign framed as stopping 'Smer taking Bratislava'. Ráž reportedly avoided several debates.

notes: 6 registered, 2 withdrew after registration (Heredoš, Winkler) — names stay on ballot, votes not counted; effective field = 4 (Vallo, Ráž, Šubová, Geci). Polls diverge sharply: SANEP/Kanal1 (CAWI) has Vallo +2.6 among decided, Ixactly/Markíza has Vallo +14.6 (≈ +17 among decided). AKO/JOJ poll due 20.10 evening reportedly shows a close race — check before finalising. Bookmakers strongly favour Vallo (implied ~93–96 %). Winkler's July support (18.5 %) partially transfers to Ráž; C&C July head-to-head had Vallo 53.7 vs Ráž 34.4. Historical: Vallo 2022 60.2 % vs combined KDH/SR/ZĽ challenger 27.7 %; turnout 36.9 % (2022), 40.7 % (2018). Polls report 'declared turnout' 42–80 % — not credible as literal turnout. Ráž is formally NEKA but widely perceived as Smer candidate (Hlavný denník: 'nom. SMER-SD'). Vallo's 2026 coalition = Team BA + PS + SaS + Demokrati.

key_events.text: Candidate lists filed; 8 mayoral candidates (Smer/Hlas/SNS/Republika/PnP coalition fields council candidates but no own mayoral candidate; Právo na pravdu backs Kovačevičová).
City election commission registers all 8 candidates.
Polaček team releases Focus poll showing him narrowly ahead; Mudrák team answers with Focus poll (9 Oct) showing Lörinc +8.
Kanal1 live debate of Košice mayoral candidates.

notes: No withdrawals found as of 2026-10-20 (all 8 still in SANEP 13–18 Oct poll; stavkynavolby lists only 6 because it omits the two fringe candidates). Genuinely open 4-way race under plurality rule: Lörinc leads 4 of 5 polls (only Polaček-commissioned Focus has Polaček first); 2nd–4th within margin. Winning threshold likely ~25–30 %. Low turnout city (30.9 % in 2022). Name-confusion risk: Lörinc (#2, Košická strana) vs Lörincz (#3, Jednota Slovanov) — Lörincz polls 2.4–4 %, part may be misdirected Lörinc votes. Polaček's 2022 coalition included SME RODINA, now not. Mudrák (PS) and Kovačevičová split the anti-incumbent vote with Lörinc. Polls from campaigns (Focus x2) should be down-weighted.

Javorčíková publishes Focus poll (Nosko +1.6) and invites Molitoris and Sobota to talks on joint approach (17 Aug); Molitoris refuses to step aside.
STVR debate of mayoral candidates (Nosko, Javorčíková, Kotleba). Nosko skipped a civil-society debate (per Javorčíková FB).

notes: 6 registered; Sobota withdrew 8 Oct (ballot no. 5, votes not counted) → 5 effective. Polls: Nosko leads all four (by 1.6–11.4 pts), lead narrowed to 6.8 in SANEP Oct after Sobota's exit; but all three bookmakers make Javorčíková slight favourite (implied ~55–58 %) — a notable polls-vs-market divergence. Nosko won 2022 with 66 % vs Javorčíková 25 % on 39.8 % turnout; he is formally independent but drew support from the governing coalition (Hlas, Smer, SNS, Sme rodina in 2022) — national anti-government mood could hurt him. Molitoris (12–19 %) splits the change vote. Ballot numbers inferred from alphabetical registration order (topky table shows 1–4 and 6 with Sobota as 5); official city PDF not read directly.

notes: 4 candidates, no withdrawals. Structural change vs 2022: Hattas consolidated the opposition parties (PS, KDH, SaS, Demokrati, HS, OKS) behind his regional party; Kršiak lost his 2022 coalition backing (Hlas/Sme rodina) and the government parties field Illéš (Smer/Hlas/SR) and Uhríková (Republika/SNS) separately, splitting the anti-Hattas vote. 2022 Hattas won only 30.8 % with Štefek (20.0) and Obertáš (17.5) not running now. Only one independent poll (AKO) — Hattas +22.7; campaign-released polls: Infostat Hattas +9.9, Focus tie. Bookmakers imply Hattas ~75–80 %. ballot_no for Nitra from topky 'v poradí podľa hlasovacieho lístka'.
